failures.label: illegal_u_turn
failures.title: A 30-second "U-turn"
failures.text: A car waiting in the left-turn pocket crept forward for half a minute while its heading drifted by 150 degrees. The rule accumulated the drift. Next step: cap the manoeuvre at 12 s and require real displacement.

failures.label: stopped_vehicle
failures.title: A parked car flagged for the whole video
failures.text: A car parked legally on the far kerb sits inside the area we traced as carriageway. The layout polygon needs a parking-bay cut-out.

failures.label: failure_to_yield
failures.title: Sub-second failure_to_yield blips
failures.text: When a car passes, the pedestrian's box flickers onto the roadway part of the zebra. These 0.3 s events can never reach tIoU 0.3 against a real label. A 1 s minimum duration removes them.

failures.label: red_light
failures.title: Red-light runners on the far carriageway
failures.text: Vehicles on the far side are small and the tracker loses them inside the junction box, so the "enters the box on red" condition never completes.
